tools.name: Hourly rate
tools.desc: Work out the minimum hourly rate you need from your take-home pay, tax, expenses and time off. Free, private, no sign-up.

tools.name: Project quote
tools.desc: Price a project with a buffer, costs and a deposit, and see what the quote really pays you per hour. Free, no sign-up.

tools.name: Invoice
tools.desc: Create an invoice with line items and tax, then print or save it as a PDF. Nothing you type is uploaded.

tools.name: Markup & margin
tools.desc: Enter a cost plus a markup, margin or price to see all three side by side, with the difference explained.

tools.name: Retainer
tools.desc: Compare a monthly retainer with hourly billing and see the break-even hours and what changes if usage changes.

tools.name: Late fee
tools.desc: Add interest and a flat fee to an overdue invoice and see the total you can ask for.

tools.name: Tax
tools.desc: Estimate the tax and social contributions on your freelance profit, and how much to set aside each quarter.

tools.name: PPP pricing
tools.desc: Enter your US price and see a fair price for each country, based on what money buys there.
